title: DEF-001 verify — root compose.yaml exists and stack boots (postgres, redis, backend, frontend, celery)
objective: Verify the Backend agent delivered the root compose.yaml with all Cycle-2 services and that the documented bootstrap brings up a healthy stack.
preconditions: Clean checkout; Docker available in execution environment (else BLOCKED with justification).
steps: Verify compose.yaml present at repo root with services: frontend, backend, postgres, redis, celery-worker (+celery-beat/minio if declared).
Run documented bootstrap; check /api/v1/health/ready 200 and frontend 200.
Verify non-root containers and health checks configured per design §16.
expected_result: compose.yaml exists and boots the full stack healthy; scripts idempotent; closes DEF-001.
automation_status: automatable where Docker available; else BLOCKED

title: DEF-002 verify — root .env.example complete, placeholder-only, .env git-ignored
objective: Verify .env.example documents every required env var (secret key, DB, CORS/CSRF origins, API base URL, celery/redis) with placeholders only and .env is git-ignored.
test_data: file inspection; grep for real-looking secrets
steps: Open .env.example; cross-check vars against settings fail-fast requirements (D-13) and compose service env.
Verify no real secrets; verify .gitignore covers .env; verify .env untracked.
expected_result: .env.example complete + placeholder-only; .env ignored/untracked; README references it; closes DEF-002.

title: DEF-003/ADR-004 verify — Idempotency-Key landed on asset create + lifecycle endpoints
objective: Confirm the Cycle-1 deferral is closed: idempotency implemented and tested for asset create and all Cycle-2 transition endpoints (executed via TC-D08-01…03).
test_data: results of TC-D08 suite; OpenAPI schema headers documentation
steps: Verify TC-D08-01…03 results are PASSED (or file defects).
Verify OpenAPI documents Idempotency-Key header on the relevant POST operations.
expected_result: All idempotency tests pass; contract documents the header; ADR-004 marked closed; closes DEF-003.

title: DEF-004/ADR-003 verify — backend/uv.lock committed and reproducible
objective: Verify uv.lock is committed at backend/ and dependency resolution is reproducible (or a recorded ADR explains continued absence).
preconditions: Repo access; uv available or Docker build.
steps: Verify backend/uv.lock exists and is tracked.
Verify locked versions satisfy pyproject ranges; verify Dockerfile/CI installs from the lock (frozen) where documented.
expected_result: uv.lock committed, consistent with pyproject; install path uses the lock; closes DEF-004 (or ADR updated with approved rationale).

title: DEF-006 verify — reference-data DELETE semantics: deactivate-in-use, delete-only-unused, audited
objective: Verify the corrected DELETE/deactivate behavior for reference data: in-use values are deactivated (not deleted), unused values may be deleted, FK PROTECT honored, all audited.
preconditions: Admin session; a category/status/location referenced by assets; an unused reference-data row.
test_data: in-use location L-used; unused supplier S-unused
steps: DELETE (or deactivate) L-used → verify it becomes inactive but remains referenced; assets still resolve it.
Verify inactive values excluded from create/edit form option lists but retained on existing records/history.
DELETE S-unused → verify actual removal permitted (or documented uniform-deactivate policy).
Verify audit events for both actions; verify non-admin cannot perform either (403).
expected_result: BR-004 honored: in-use values never hard-deleted (deactivate instead); no broken references; option lists filter inactive; audit trail complete; closes DEF-006.

title: Cycle-1 npm-audit critical dev dependency resolved
objective: Verify the critical npm-audit finding (transitive dev dependency) from Cycle 1 is fixed or has a recorded risk decision; npm audit shows no unresolved criticals.
test_data: npm audit output (production + dev noted separately)
steps: Run npm audit in frontend/; capture JSON/text output.
If findings remain, verify a documented risk decision (dev-only, non-shipped) exists in frontend README/ASSUMPTIONS.
expected_result: No unresolved critical vulnerabilities without recorded risk decision; production dependency tree clean of criticals.
automation_status: automatable (npm audit via allowlisted command if available)
